10. The Equitable Basic Physician plan will provide 100% reimbursement up to the Reasonable and Customary charge for surgical services. All other types of services shall continue to be reimbursed according to the schedule of allowances provided in the plan.

11. Annual Medical Examinations are available upon request to full-time permanent employees. Arrangements are made through Health Service. The fee for the examination is $30. Effective November 30, 1981, the fee is reduced to $25.

ARTICLE XV - GROUP LIFE INSURANCE

The Employer shall continue to grant $3,000.00 of the Employer's group life insurance coverage at the Employer's expense to all full-time employees covered by this Agreement, upon completion of the three (3) months probationary period of employment. Full-time employees covered by this Agreement may participate in additional group life insurance coverage, based upon their entitlement to such coverage and the required employee contribution set forth in the following schedule:
